About me

From biology and operations to cloud technology.

I’m moving into cloud technology through hands-on training and projects.

My transition

I earned a B.S. in Biology from Seton Hall University. My degree taught me how to analyze information, document my work, and stay patient when a problem takes time to solve.

I also work in high-volume port operations. I set up devices and troubleshoot technical issues while thousands of passengers move through the terminal.

I wanted to move further into technology, so I joined AWS re/Start at Per Scholas. I’m now learning AWS, Linux, networking, Python, and cloud security. I’m interested in entry-level cloud support, operations, and engineering roles.
